tasks.label: merge-rust-verify-2
tasks.command: $env:PATH = $env:USERPROFILE + '\.cargo\bin;' + $env:PATH; $cargo = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo\bin\cargo.exe'; Set-Location d:\RustProject\VeloGuard\rust; & $cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings *> $env:TEMP\vg-verify\rclippy2.log; & $cargo test --workspace --all-targets *> $env:TEMP\vg-verify\rtest2.log; Write-Output RUST_VERIFY_2_DONE
